title: Kyle Shanahan expected to coach 49ers Week 1 opener in Australia after recovering from car accident, says GM John Lynch

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kyle Shanahan expected to coach 49ers Week 1 opener in Australia after recovering from car accident, says GM John Lynch
sources.description: Lynch explained that Shanahan will essentially go through the same concussion protocol as players before being deemed fit to return.
